title: Old Baghdad & Salman Pak
full_text:
7 AM Start the day with a thick-cream and pastry breakfast (Qaimer and Kahi).
Old Baghdad tour via Al Rasheed street, visiting various local markets such as the copper market "Al Safafeer", Souq Al Sarai - the stationary market, Books market "Al Mutanabbi street" and antiques market "Khan Al Mudalal".
Visit heritage sites such as Madrasa Mustansiriya School and the Abbasid Palace.
This tour includes a boat ride activity at the Tigris river and an explanation about the statue of the poet Al - Mutanabbi.
Old Baghdad offers many local food restaurants along Hayder Khana street, such as Kubba Al Sarai, Oum Kalthoum Shawarma or any other of your favourite. We also will grab a treat from both Al Shahbender cafe and Haj Zbala Juice shop.
After lunch start heading to Salman Pak:
Visiting Taq Kasra "the Arch of Ctesiphon" - the largest single-span vault of unreinforced brickwork according to the world history of architecture, served as a royal capital of the Parthian and Sasanian empires.
We can witness the sunset from the neglected panorama building.
At night we will have free time for dinner, café or drink.
